name: an unreachable store makes the sanity check ERR_CHECK_FAILED
description: The sanity check shares ERR_CHECK_FAILED with the presence check because both mean the same thing to the caller: the index could not be inspected. What matters is that the failure is not folded into sane:false, which reads as "the mapping is stale, reindex" — a full reindex is the most expensive thing an administrator can be told to do, and it must never be triggered by a connection error.
